cause: The parent's initial protocol explicitly names nonvoid conditional probabilities. Some original boundary-plan fields used the shorter word conditional for a decisive-result normalization. Those are distinct conditioning events.

definitions.nonvoid: Condition on action/nonvoid. Push remains a third outcome; over+under+push=1 within that condition.
definitions.decisive: Condition additionally on not pushing. Normalize over and under by over+under; undefined when decisive mass is zero.
definitions.unconditional_placed: Win/loss probabilities per placed unit; residual push/void mass refunds under the registered contract. EV=p_win*(decimal_odds-1)-p_loss.

fixture_interpretations.clarification: conditional_EV=0.2 is conditional_decisive_EV. With zero void mass, nonvoid EV remains0.1 and push mass remains0.5. Multiplying0.2 by decisive mass0.5 recovers0.1.

0.55/0.45 are decisive-normalized diagnostics. Under the parent's nonvoid policy and zero void mass, use over0.33/under0.27/push0.40; do not discard push for proper scoring or priced EV. Both comparisons choose Over.

A law concentrated on the line has undefined decisive probabilities. Its nonvoid probabilities remain over0/under0/push1; P2 abstains on tied win probabilities. The zero-decisive-mass diagnostic is separate from missing nonvoid participation probability.
